Decorative flex heading flourish beside Where next; preserve geometry and remove inset painted rule.
Rendered screenshot proves this line joins the dated event markers.
Rendered segments duplicate phase labels that already carry the active color and semibold weight; preserve ordered labels and phase meaning.
